description:
• Brand introduction: At Inner Carrera, we are creating a new definition of healthy skin. Our commitment to innovation drives us to create groundbreaking skincare products that anticipate our customer's needs and to exceed our cutomer's expectations. As we peer into the future, we envision a world where radiant, healthy skin is accessible to all.

• Product description: This Body serum is made with four simple ingredients and is scent free. Body Serum It includes a mixture of castor oil, vitamin E oil, and Aloe Vera. Body Serum Castor oil has great properties to hydrate the damaged skin barrier while vitamin E oil is an essential nutrient for skin health. Body Serum Aloe Vera is a non-inflammatory, aqueous product that helps the absorption of the oil into the skin. Body Serum Polysorbate 80 used to combine the Aloe Vera with these oils is a typical product used as an emulsifier in many foods and cosmetic products Body Serum.
• USP (Unique Selling Point): Our product is a ground-breaking innovation that allows people with dry skin and eczema to enjoy the luxury experience of hydration. This is a serum that hydrates like a lotion, but absorbs as a serum. No longer does one have to put a layer of lotion on only for themselves to feel sticky and the lotion not work! Put a few drops on anywhere on your body and rub into the skin with instant relief! Its all-natural ingredients are perfect for sensitive skin and is designed to calm inflammation!
• Payment terms: You pay us, we pay YOU MORE! All introductory levels start out at 10% per sale.
• Other information: Feel free to reach out via SMS at 480-329-7312, via our website at innercarrera.com, or email: innercarrera@gmail.com!
